author: AWARESPAN Safety Engineering
description: Comprehensive, vendor-agnostic threat and safety event taxonomy for edge multimodal intelligence.

categories.description: Visible firearms, bladed weapons, and destructive tools requiring rapid deterrence and operator alerting.
Objectively observable kinetic actions indicating physical distress, falls, or interpersonal violence.
Wildlife, livestock, or domestic animal detections. Passive presence is informational; proximity/aggression triggers safety alerts.
Visible flame, smoke plume, or rapid thermal hazards threatening human life and infrastructure.
Objective boundary violations, restricted-zone entries, or unauthorized physical incursions.
Auditory signatures of immediate danger, including gunshots, human screams, glass breakage, and industrial alarms.

weapon.firearm.handgun.definition: Compact firearm designed for one- or two-handed operation, visible in human hand or exposed holster.
weapon.firearm.handgun.evidence_requirements: Single high-confidence visual bounding box or multi-frame persistence >= 2 frames.

weapon.firearm.rifle.definition: Long-barrel firearm with shoulder stock or extended barrel.

weapon.edged.knife.definition: Sharp edged or pointed implement with exposed blade held in offensive or drawn posture.

weapon.edged.machete.definition: Large bladed implement (> 25cm blade) visible in perimeter or public zone.

human_activity.violence.fighting.definition: Rapid reciprocal striking, grappling, or aggressive physical struggle between multiple individuals.

human_activity.distress.fall.definition: Sudden descent of a person to ground followed by sustained horizontal stillness.
human_activity.distress.fall.evidence_requirements: Rapid downward displacement followed by non-upright posture >= 3s.

animal.wildlife.general.definition: Presence of non-human fauna in monitored environment (mammal, bird, livestock).
animal.wildlife.general.evidence_requirements: Visual bounding box. Defaults to passive logging unless proximity rules trigger.

animal.wildlife.predator.definition: Potentially hazardous wildlife (bear, big cat, boar) near human activity perimeter.
animal.wildlife.predator.evidence_requirements: Visual detection with verified species label.

hazard.fire.flame.definition: Visible open combustion or flickering flame in uncontained area.
hazard.fire.flame.evidence_requirements: Sustained flame detection across >= 2 consecutive frames.

hazard.fire.smoke.definition: Dense rising or accumulating smoke plume obscuring background.
hazard.fire.smoke.evidence_requirements: Volumetric particulate detection over temporal window.

intrusion.perimeter.breach.definition: Physical crossing of defined virtual tripwire or boundary line by person or vehicle.
intrusion.perimeter.breach.evidence_requirements: Centroid vector trajectory crossing polygon boundary.

audio.threat.gunshot.definition: Impulsive acoustic shockwave with rapid rise time (< 5ms) and reverberant decay.
audio.threat.gunshot.evidence_requirements: Spectral peak and acoustic classifier output matching firearm profile.

audio.threat.scream.definition: High-intensity vocalization in 1-4 kHz formant frequency range characteristic of distress.
audio.threat.scream.evidence_requirements: Acoustic classifier score >= threshold over >= 400ms duration.

audio.threat.glass_break.definition: High-frequency shatter and impact noise in 3-10 kHz range.
audio.threat.glass_break.evidence_requirements: Acoustic classifier output matching glass shatter profile.

audio.threat.alarm.definition: Periodic or continuous tonal alarm sound (e.g., smoke detector, car alarm, siren).
audio.threat.alarm.evidence_requirements: Repeated tonal harmonic peak matching alarm signatures.
